Container.Name: seadex-scout
Container.Overview: Compares your Sonarr and Radarr anime library with SeaDex (seadex.moe), the community list of the best release for each show, and shows where a better release exists. This fork has its own web dashboard on port 9119: upgrades available, a library overview, the scout's health and on-demand reports, with no Grafana, Loki or Alertmanager needed. It never downloads anything; Sonarr and Radarr stay in charge.
Container.Requires: A Sonarr instance, a Radarr instance or both, with anime in them.

Config.Name: SeaDex Scout: config folder
Config.Description: config.yaml, saved state, the dashboard's state and the reports folder.

Config.Name: SeaDex Scout: dashboard port
Config.Description: The built-in web dashboard.

Config.Name: SeaDex Scout: dashboard user name
Config.Description: The user name for the dashboard sign-in, used only when a password is set.

Config.Name: SeaDex Scout: dashboard password
Config.Description: Optional. Set it to require a sign-in (user name below) for the dashboard. Empty leaves the dashboard open to your network.

Config.Name: SeaDex Scout: dashboard address
Config.Description: Optional. The address you open the dashboard at, such as http://192.168.1.10:9119/, for a Dashboard button on each ntfy notification.

Config.Name: SeaDex Scout: dashboard listen port
Config.Description: The port the dashboard listens on inside the container. Set to off to turn the dashboard off. If you change it, change the container port above too.

Config.Name: SeaDex Scout: saved SeaDex data limit
Config.Description: Each full check saves SeaDex's data to the config folder. If SeaDex can't be reached, checks compare against that saved copy while it is younger than this, such as 30d or 720h; 0 means no limit. The copy is never deleted.

Config.Name: Sonarr: URL
Config.Description: The address you open Sonarr at from another device, such as http://192.168.1.10:8989. Not localhost. Leave empty to turn Sonarr off.

Config.Name: Sonarr: API key
Config.Description: Sonarr, Settings, General, API Key.

Config.Name: Radarr: URL
Config.Description: Optional. The address you open Radarr at, such as http://192.168.1.10:7878.

Config.Name: Radarr: API key
Config.Description: Radarr, Settings, General, API Key.

Config.Name: qBittorrent: URL
Config.Description: Optional. qBittorrent's Web UI address, such as http://192.168.1.10:8080, to show a Send to qBittorrent button under each Nyaa link. Use the server's LAN address, not a Tailscale name.

Config.Name: qBittorrent: user name
Config.Description: The qBittorrent Web UI user. Leave empty if qBittorrent skips sign-in for local addresses.

Config.Name: qBittorrent: password
Config.Description: The qBittorrent Web UI password.

Config.Name: qBittorrent: category for Sonarr
Config.Description: The category Sonarr releases are added under: use the one Sonarr's qBittorrent download client uses, so Sonarr imports them. Empty adds them with no category.

Config.Name: qBittorrent: category for Radarr
Config.Description: The category Radarr releases are added under: use the one Radarr's qBittorrent download client uses, so Radarr imports them. Empty adds them with no category.

Config.Name: Prowlarr: URL
Config.Description: Optional. Prowlarr's address, such as http://192.168.1.10:9696, for a → Prowlarr button under each Nyaa link: it searches your indexers for the Nyaa release's title and sends the usenet copy you pick to SABnzbd. Needs the SABnzbd fields too. Use the server's LAN address, not a Tailscale name.

Config.Name: Prowlarr: API key
Config.Description: Prowlarr, Settings, General, API Key. Used by the → Prowlarr button, and by the optional indexer when config.yaml names ${SEADEX_SCOUT_PROWLARR_KEY}.

Config.Name: SABnzbd: URL
Config.Description: Optional. SABnzbd's address, such as http://192.168.1.10:8080. Use the server's LAN address, not a Tailscale name.

Config.Name: SABnzbd: API key
Config.Description: SABnzbd, Config, General, API Key (not the NZB key).

Config.Name: SABnzbd: category for Sonarr
Config.Description: The SABnzbd category Sonarr releases go to: use the one Sonarr's SABnzbd download client uses, so Sonarr imports them. Empty uses SABnzbd's default.

Config.Name: SABnzbd: category for Radarr
Config.Description: The SABnzbd category Radarr releases go to: use the one Radarr's SABnzbd download client uses, so Radarr imports them. Empty uses SABnzbd's default.

Config.Name: ntfy: topic URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your ntfy topic's full address, such as https://ntfy.sh/my-seadex-topic, to get a message for each new upgrade and each problem. Pick a long, hard-to-guess topic name on the public server.

Config.Name: ntfy: access token
Config.Description: Optional. An ntfy access token (tk_...) for a protected topic.

Config.Name: ntfy: user name
Config.Description: Optional. For a protected topic, instead of a token.

Config.Name: ntfy: password
Config.Description: Optional. For a protected topic, instead of a token.

Config.Name: ntfy: events
Config.Description: What to send, comma-separated: upgrades (new upgrades and newer versions), problems (SeaDex down, stalled checks and so on, and when they end), errors (at most once per error every 6 hours), reports (a report you started finished).

Config.Name: ntfy: optional upgrades
Config.Description: true also sends upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt.

Config.Name: ntfy: unmonitored
Config.Description: true also sends upgrades for unmonitored series, seasons and movies.

Config.Name: Indexer: port
Config.Description: Only used by the optional Torznab indexer, which offers SeaDex's picks to Sonarr and Radarr as an indexer. It listens only once the indexer section of config.yaml is filled in. Not needed for the dashboard's → qBit and → Prowlarr buttons.

Config.Name: Indexer: feed key
Config.Description: Only used by the optional Torznab indexer, and only when config.yaml's indexer.feed_api_key is written as ${SEADEX_SCOUT_FEED_KEY}. The first start already writes a generated key into config.yaml, so this is normally left empty.

Config.Name: Indexer: AnimeBytes passkey
Config.Description: Only used by the optional Torznab indexer with an AnimeBytes account, and only when config.yaml's indexer.ab_passkey is written as ${SEADEX_SCOUT_AB_PASSKEY}. Leave empty otherwise.
